places.name: Charminar
places.blurb: Four minarets, four grand arches, built in 1591 at the heart of the new city. Traffic still swirls around it.

places.name: Mecca Masjid
places.blurb: One of the largest mosques in India. Bricks for its central arch are said to be made with soil from Mecca.

places.name: Laad Bazaar
places.blurb: A glittering lane of lac bangles, pearls and wedding shopping that has traded for four centuries.

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.blurb: Seat of the Nizams: courtyards, fountains, a clock tower that has ticked since the 1700s.

places.name: Falaknuma Palace
places.blurb: "Mirror of the sky" - a scorpion-shaped hilltop palace looking down over the Old City.

places.name: Salar Jung Museum
places.blurb: A vast one-family art collection on the bank of the Musi, famous for its veiled marble Rebecca.

places.name: High Court
places.blurb: Pink granite and red sandstone domes rising from the south bank of the Musi since 1920.

places.name: Osmania General Hospital
places.blurb: A century-old Indo-Saracenic hospital with great onion domes facing the river.

places.name: Nehru Zoological Park
places.blurb: Lions, elephants, a toy train and a safari loop beside Mir Alam Tank.

places.name: Mir Alam Tank
places.blurb: A reservoir held back by a dam of 21 stone arches, built in 1806.

places.name: Hussain Sagar Buddha
places.blurb: An 18-metre monolith standing on the Rock of Gibraltar in the middle of the lake.

places.name: Tank Bund
places.blurb: The dam road that joins the twin cities, lined with statues and evening walkers.

places.name: Necklace Road
places.blurb: The lakeside boulevard that glitters like a string of pearls at night, under a giant tricolour.

places.name: Lumbini Park
places.blurb: Boat jetty to the Buddha statue, plus a laser show every evening.

places.name: NTR Gardens
places.blurb: Lawns, a toy train and a memorial beside the lake.

places.name: Birla Mandir
places.blurb: A temple of white Rajasthani marble on Naubat Pahad, glowing over the lake after dark.

places.name: Secretariat
places.blurb: The domed seat of the Telangana government on the southern shore.

places.name: Legislative Assembly
places.blurb: A white Rajasthani-Persian hall with gleaming domes, built in 1913.

places.name: Public Gardens
places.blurb: The Nizam's Bagh-e-Aam: old trees, a lotus pond and a bandstand.

places.name: Nampally Station
places.blurb: Hyderabad Deccan station, the old terminus of the Nizam's railway.

places.name: Abids
places.blurb: The old shopping heart of the city, around the General Post Office.

places.name: Secunderabad Clock Tower
places.blurb: A 37-metre tower from 1897 standing in a small park in the cantonment town.

places.name: Secunderabad Junction
places.blurb: A fort-like station from 1874 and one of the busiest rail hubs of the Deccan.

places.name: Parade Ground
places.blurb: A wide open maidan for parades, kite festivals and weekend cricket.

places.name: St. Mary's Basilica
places.blurb: A Gothic basilica begun in 1840, once the largest church in the Nizam's dominions.

places.name: OU Arts College
places.blurb: Osmania University's granite landmark, its giant arch blending Ajanta and Qutb Shahi styles.

places.name: Uppal Stadium
places.blurb: Home of Hyderabad cricket. On match nights the floodlights can be seen for miles.

places.name: Ramoji Film City
places.blurb: A film studio the size of a town: palaces, streets and whole cities built as sets.

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.blurb: A granite hill fortress once known for its diamonds. A clap at the gate can be heard at the top.

places.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
places.blurb: Domed tombs of seven kings resting in a garden near the fort.

places.name: Taramati Baradari
places.blurb: A twelve-arched music pavilion whose songs were said to carry to Golconda.

places.name: Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge
places.blurb: A cable-stayed bridge over the "secret lake", lit up in colours every night.

places.name: Cyber Towers
places.blurb: The round-cornered tower that started HITEC City in 1998.

places.name: Shilparamam
places.blurb: A crafts village of thatched stalls, pottery and folk performances.

places.name: Gachibowli Stadium
places.blurb: An athletics and football arena built for the 2003 Afro-Asian Games.

places.name: Financial District
places.blurb: Glass towers on what was boulder country twenty years ago.

places.name: KBR Park
places.blurb: A patch of Deccan forest in Jubilee Hills, with peacocks and a morning walkers' loop.

places.name: Shamshabad Airport
places.blurb: Rajiv Gandhi International. Watch for departures along the runway.
